```{r}
for (i in seq_len(5)) {
  tempString = paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse="")
  print(tempString)
}
```
```{r}
breakfasts = c("eggs", "toast", "porridge", "bacon", "cereal", "yogurt", "granola bar", "hashbrowns", "sausages", "beans", "fruit")
nums = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
breakfasts_table = tibble()

for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  breakfast_item = sample(breakfasts, size = 1)
  number_items = sample(nums, size = 1)
  row = tibble(
    item = breakfast_item,
    number = number_items
  )
  breakfasts_table = bind_rows(breakfasts_table, row)
}
gt(breakfasts_table)
```
